content: कपिल {%a.%} [कपि-लच्] .²1 Tawny, reddish; वाताय कपिला विद्युत् <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. II. 3. 13</ls>. .²2 Having tawny hairs; नोद्वहेत्कपिलां कन्याम् <ls>Ms. 3. 8</ls>. (<ls>Kull.</ls> = कपिलकेशा). .{@-लः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a great sage. [He reduced to ashes 60000 sons of Sagara, who while searching for the sacrificial horse of their father taken away by Indra, fell in with him and accused him of having stolen it (see <ls>U. 1. 23</ls>). He is also said to have been the founder of the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy.] ऋषि प्रसूतं कपिलं यस्तमग्रे ज्ञानैर्बिभर्ति <ls>Śāṅk. Bhāṣ.</ls> on <ls>Bād. Sūtras 2. 1</ls>; सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः <ls>Bg. 10. 26</ls>. .²2 A dog. .²3 Benzoin. .²4 Incense. .²5 A form or fire. .²6 The tawny colour. .²7 Impure benzoin. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the sun. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .²10 One of the incarnation of Viṣṇu. .{@-ला@} .²1 A brown cow; कपिला चेत्तारयति भूयश्चासप्तमं कुलम् <ls>Y. 1. 205</ls>. .²2 A kind of perfume. .²3 A kind of timber. .²4 The common leech. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the female elephant of the south east.
